meta.name: supply-chain-hardening
meta.description: Configure install-time cooldowns for npm/bun (minimum release age) and run a sandboxed pre-install scan when the cooldown has to be bypassed. Use when the user asks about supply-chain attacks, npm/bun security, "minimum release age", a "cooldown" for installs, hardening against Shai-Hulud-class worms, or how to safely install a package that was just published. Also use after any recent supply-chain incident in the npm ecosystem.
